skills.name: Libromancy
skills.description: Calls lightning down upon the enemy, inflicting harmful effects.  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -40% (10 sec) *Enemy Skill Resistance -40% (10 sec)

skills.name: Arbitre d'Enfer
skills.description: Locks on to multiple enemies and rains down black magic blasts on them, inflicting harmful effects. *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK per sec x 300% Area Damage (8 sec) *Makes enemy skills unusable (8 sec) *Applies charm effect to 1 enemies within range. (8 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Sakura Wars
abilities.description: Sakura Wars Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
